verdict.rationale: The pack never documents a user-facing bulk operation, such as selecting many destinations, streams, functions or events and acting on them in one step. Nearby items don't count: optional delivery batching, automatic identity-stitching amendments and dead-letter replay are different features. The Management API, CLI and MCP server are building blocks an agent could script against, not a bulk-operations capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
